defaults.mod_settings.description: Host the shared Mod Settings child over Mode Select and own its session-wide runtime state.

prepare_during_mode_select_construction.description: Construct Mode Select normally, then prepare the Mod Settings backdrop, child, and title before the first Mode Select draw.

open_and_update_from_mode_select.description: Open Mod Settings on Square, update its shared Practice child, and suppress Mode Select input while it is active.

draw_over_mode_select.description: Draw Mode Select normally until Mod Settings replaces it with the Options backdrop and shared Practice child.

draw_mode_select_footer_prompt.description: Retain the native START prompt draw and append the Mode Select-only Square Mod prompt before the label sprite is finalized.

cleanup_before_accept.description: Destroy an active Mod Settings child before the accepted Mode Select controller is released.

cleanup_before_back.description: Destroy an active Mod Settings child before the cancelled Mode Select controller is released.

defaults.mod_settings.simple_display.description: Use one Simple Display value for native gameplay, both menus, and saves.

apply_simple_display_state.description: Store the runtime-selected Simple Display bit during native manager-pack initialization.

select_current_simple_display_value.description: Initialize the selected row from the active native Simple Display value while keeping automatic completion disabled.

draw_player_markers_with_simple_display.description: Draw the 1P, 2P, and COM markers above fighters only while Simple Display is on.

shared_simple_display_get.description: Read the shared Mod Settings value through the native Simple Display getter.

shared_simple_display_set.description: Commit native Simple Display changes through the shared setter used by Mod Settings and saves.

defaults.match_setup.character_balance.description: Select per-character battle values from the generated character-override table.

select_cost_for_live_fighter.description: Replace the native cost transfer and delay slot with a guarded call that passes the live fighter while preserving the following subtraction and clamp.

defaults.battle_mechanics.chakra.description: Share one selectable Chakra behavior between Battle Settings and Practice Settings.

defaults.battle_mechanics.xdash_chakra_c.description: Spend the configured chakra cost on the first fighter update after X-dash becomes non-cancellable.

defaults.description: Apply independent configured native defaults to Battle and Practice manager state.

skip_native_battle_select_defaults.description: Continue the Battle Select action at its sound and notice after skipping native writes to the entire root page.

update_shared_fighter_settings.description: Preserve the native per-fighter update while applying shared X-dash charging before it and the selected Chakra behavior after it.

native_defaults_apply_battle_defaults_wh.description: Preserve the mode-2 manager assignment, apply the configured Battle default pack, and rejoin the native mode-selection flow.

native_defaults_apply_mode_defaults_afte.description: Preserve the native Strength mirror write, then apply the configured default pack for the active Battle or Practice mode.

native_defaults_persist_active_difficult.description: Preserve the native difficulty mirror write and keep the persisted Battle Difficulty synchronized with it.

native_defaults_persist_options_difficul.description: Preserve the Options difficulty write and keep the persisted Battle Difficulty synchronized with it.

battle_initialize_active_rows_on_open.description: Run the native settings snapshot, activate the Battle root page, resolve its row resources, and stage every battle mechanic selector.

battle_release_submenu_style_resources.description: Release the Practice child-page style resources before the native Battle controller free.

battle_confirm_active_row.description: Commit every staged battle mechanic selector and close from every row, including submenu launchers, before the native settings transaction stores its own rows.

battle_handle_page_cancel.description: Return from the Battle Battle Mechanics page or retain the native root-page cancel behavior.

battle_reset_active_modes_to_configured_.description: Stage configured defaults only for rows on the active Battle page and play the native Select sound.

battle_select_defaults_message.description: Show the active Battle page name in the Select reset notice.

battle_navigate_active_rows.description: Wrap navigation over the active Battle page count.

battle_change_active_row_value.description: Open a submenu launcher on Square or change the selected mapped native value or staged battle mechanic selector within its semantic bound.

battle_route_ultimate_jutsu_value_help.description: Run the native value-specific Ultimate Jutsu help only for the semantic Ultimate Jutsu row, using Command help for the two custom contest modes.

battle_load_active_help_table_high.description: Point the native help refresh at the resolved active help table.

battle_load_active_label_table_high.description: Point the native label loop at the resolved active label table.

battle_draw_visible_label_rows.description: Draw the active Battle page's current visible label count.

battle_route_visible_time_draw.description: Use the native Time renderer only when the visible slot contains the semantic Time row.

battle_route_visible_handicap_draw.description: Use the native Handicap renderer only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_position_visible_handicap_red_val.description: Move the native red Handicap value graphics to the active visible row.

battle_position_visible_handicap_blue_va.description: Move the native blue Handicap value graphics to the active visible row.

battle_draw_active_value.description: Load an ordinary visible row through its mapped native slot or staged custom mode.

battle_draw_visible_value_rows.description: Draw the active Battle page's current visible value count.

battle_resolve_helper_maximum.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected visible row's semantic maximum.

battle_resolve_helper_value.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected visible row's mapped value.

battle_route_native_handicap_arrows.description: Use the native Handicap arrows only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_select_page_appropriate_cursor.description: Use the native Handicap cursor object only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_draw_page_backing.description: Compose the exact active row backing and position the native Handicap panel at its visible slot.

battle_draw_visible_rows.description: Update the logical scroll window, remap its visible rows, and draw them through the native table footprint.

battle_draw_visible_cursor.description: Draw the native cursor and arrows at the selected row's visible slot while retaining the logical selection.

practice_confirm_active_row.description: Apply the complete Practice transaction and close from every row, including submenu launchers.

practice_handle_page_cancel.description: Return from a Practice submenu or retain the native root-page cancel behavior.

practice_bypass_fixed_special_row_help.description: Skip the obsolete fixed-index Health, Ultimate Jutsu, and Status help refresh after a value change; the schema-driven refresh later in the same update owns it.

practice_change_active_row_value.description: Open a submenu launcher on Square or change the selected active-page row through its mapped native controller slot or custom staged value within its schema-defined bound.

practice_draw_active_value.description: Load the selected compact-table value while preserving the native value table, color, localized value adapter, and row position.

practice_draw_dynamic_cursor_geometry.description: Place the cursor from section-local visible geometry and native backing roles instead of fixed global row indices.

practice_draw_dynamic_row_count.description: Loop over the active page count rather than the native constant 17.

practice_draw_dynamic_section_boundary.description: Draw the native Opponent Settings heading at the active page's player-to-opponent boundary.

practice_load_active_page_heading.description: Load the active child page's title for the native orange Practice section heading while preserving its native text style.

practice_draw_compact_backing.description: Draw count-derived first, middle, and terminal backing cells for both sections, repeating native middle cells beyond the animation's fixed capacities.

practice_initialize_active_rows_on_open.description: Run the native snapshot, activate the root page, resolve its localized resources, and stage every battle mechanic selector.

practice_initialize_active_row_help.description: Clear the native Practice help object, then show help for the generated root page's selected row.

practice_navigate_active_rows.description: Wrap navigation over the active page count instead of the native constant 17.

practice_prepare_compact_backing_layout.description: After native animation advance and before hierarchy composition, assign first, middle, and terminal backing roles from each section's actual row count and place the Opponent heading at the resulting boundary.

practice_reset_active_rows_to_defaults.description: Stage configured defaults only for rows on the active Practice or Mod page.

practice_select_defaults_message.description: Show the active Practice or Mod page name in the Select reset notice.

practice_resolve_helper_maximum.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected schema row's dynamic maximum.

practice_resolve_helper_value.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected schema row's active value.

practice_route_row_availability.description: Evaluate enabled and grey states by semantic row behavior rather than fixed display indices.

practice_update_dynamic_scroll_flags.description: Derive upper and lower scroll indicators from each compact section's actual count.

practice_update_dynamic_windows.description: Update the two native animated row windows from the compact player and opponent counts and their dynamic boundary.

practice_update_schema_help.description: Resolve running help from the selected semantic row, including every custom selector explanation.

practice_update_selected_row_section.description: Keep the native selected-row arrow Y calculation but compare against the compact player-section count.

shared_content_arrow_availability.description: Show value arrows only on enabled rows other than a native-style Handicap row.

defaults.battle_mechanics.items.description: Shared Items presets and a configurable weighted Custom item pool.

choose_custom_field_item_0.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_1.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_2.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_3.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

spawn_selected_field_item_0.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_1.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_2.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_3.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

shared_items_amount.description: Resolve the shared Items selection for the native amount branches.

custom_small_chakra_pickups.description: Apply the Chakra Ball choice to the small chakra pickups emitted by native amount handling.

defaults.match_setup.extended_items.description: Keep the native three-slot inventory when off, or enable five slots with a mirrored item-wheel sweep.

latch_panel_extended_items.description: Latch Extended Items and clear the side's added slots before the panel constructor seeds items.

finish_panel_layout.description: Move the wheel origin and item-select badge after construction when Extended Items is on.

route_full_test.description: Treat the inventory as full only when every configured slot is occupied.

route_selected_count.description: Read the count of the occupied slot at a selection step.

route_find_code.description: Search every configured slot for an item code.

route_code_at_step.description: Read the item code of the occupied slot at a selection step.

route_count_copy.description: Count occupied slots for the full test.

route_room.description: Report how many more of an item fit across the configured slots.

route_add.description: Stack or place items across the configured slots.

route_consume_code.description: Consume an item by code across the configured slots.

route_consume_selected.description: Consume the item at a selection step across the configured slots.

route_step_occupied.description: Step through occupied slots across the configured count.

route_step_empty.description: Step through empty slots across the configured count.

route_cache_build.description: Capture every configured slot for Practice restore.

route_cache_restore.description: Restore every configured slot from the Practice capture.

route_relation.description: Classify a configured slot relative to the selection.

route_category.description: Read the category of a configured slot.

route_use_code.description: Resolve the selected item for the use input across the configured slots.

route_two_occupied.description: Allow selection changes when at least two configured slots are occupied.

route_draw.description: Draw five slots along a mirrored sweep through the selection.

route_cache_clear.description: Clear the configured Practice capture together with the native cache.

activation_occupied_count.description: Count occupied configured slots before activation.

activation_selected_slot.description: Resolve the selected configured slot during activation.

update_occupied_count.description: Capture signed selection steps, advance the blend, and count configured slots before native animation clamping.

update_selected_code.description: Read the selected code from a configured slot for the panel icon.

draw_selection_arrows.description: Count configured slots when choosing the panel's selection indicator.

defaults.battle_mechanics.substitution_i.description: Select vanilla attack timing, Hold, or a total pre-impact input window of 1 through 15 frames while preserving resource, response, state, and attack-block gates.

select_substitution_input_window.description: Resume native random and clamped timing for Default; otherwise search the current record for Hold or convert the selected total window to prior-history frames, and rejoin the guard-age and history checks.

defaults.battle_mechanics.substitution_r.description: Own ordinary substitution resource routing across selectable Chakra, Gauge, and Free modes; charge Gauge from the character override's normalized substitution cost, recover it on the native battle clock and committed HP loss, and draw its independent textured top-HUD bar without modifying the native support renderer.

adjust_battle_hud_character_name_y.description: Add the gauge-only vertical offset after the native renderer has resolved the Battle HUD character-name Y anchor, then retain its scale multiplication and side load.

gate_ordinary_substitution_with_stock.description: Route the native resource comparison through the selected Chakra, Gauge, or Free predicate, then rejoin the unchanged normalized acceptance branch.

spend_stock_without_chakra.description: After native charged-transition setup, retain the complete native chakra path in Chakra mode, spend the resolved gauge cost in Gauge mode, or spend nothing in Free mode.

restart_delay_after_every_success.description: Restart recovery after charged and deliberately free substitution transitions, then call the displaced native success helper once and preserve its return value.

sample_committed_fighter_hp.description: Sample normalized HP once on the shared active-fighter path, then call the adjacent displaced native update exactly once without overlapping the X-dash hook.

advance_on_native_battle_clock.description: Advance both slots once per native 30-FPS update when scheduler and terminal flags permit, then retain the displaced countdown call and return value.

reset_on_new_battle_construction.description: Initialize both manager-owned slots after the two fighter pointers are published in the one-time battle-graph construction branch, then retain the displaced native call.

cache_substitution_gauge_render_source.description: Retain the native support-controller update, then cache its initialized per-side sprite and BTL rendering context without drawing through the support-controller lifecycle.

draw_independent_substitution_gauge_with.description: Retain the primary per-side Battle HUD draw, then draw the independent substitution bar only after the native parent visibility gate accepts that HUD side, using the same live layout transform and primary-sprite alpha.

defaults.battle_mechanics.ultimate_jutsu.description: Back the shared Ultimate Jutsu selector with runtime state and guarded contest and HUD behavior.

gate_contest_press_latch.description: Read the native contest press state for native modes and return zero for No Contest and No HUD.

gate_contest_release_poll.description: Read the native contest release state for native modes and return zero for No Contest and No HUD.

gate_contest_render.description: Retain the contest object's lifecycle and render dispatch for native modes while suppressing its meter, prompts, and results for No Contest and No HUD.

transition_complete_battle_hud_during_co.description: For No HUD only, request native all-HUD transitions and retain the HP damage trail until the HUD returns.

defaults.battle_mechanics.shadowblur.description: Back the shared Shadowblur Extra Hit selector with independent runtime state and its guarded native branch.

select_shadowblur_extra_hit_path.description: Preserve the native predicate result while choosing whether the Shadowblur Extra Hit side-effect path runs.

defaults.battle_mechanics.extra_hit.description: Shared Extra Hit selection with native rejection recovery and a once-per-attack chakra penalty.

check_extra_hit.description: Apply the selector after native eligibility; rejection keeps native action-exit handling.

begin_extra_hit_attack.description: Reset initiation charging at the native generic-attack initializer.

defaults.battle_mechanics.support.description: Shared Off, Nerfed, Normal, and Unlimited support in Battle and Practice.

route_free_field_support_call.description: Route manual support input and Nerfed summon-to-attack transition.

route_support_gauge_draw.description: Draw a slim support bar below the side's item wheel, or nothing while Off.

remove_practice_link_gauge_refill.description: Remove the separate Practice General Link Gauge refill; shared Support owns Unlimited.

defaults.match_setup.balance_overlay.description: Draw each selected character's tier after its Character Select player panel and include resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

draw_character_balance_values.description: Replace the first native player-panel draw call with a wrapper that retains it, adds the selected character's tier on its side of the screen, and adds resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

defaults.match_setup.support_selection.description: Build per-player lists beginning with No Support. All filters through native selection eligibility and retains the native carousel; relevant and none use compact lists and bounded navigation. Share the No Support default, Auto Linked Mode bypass, and special-entry display and name handling.

route_default_support_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's default-support compatibility path while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_initial_support_list_population.description: Route initial Character Select support-list population through the per-player list wrapper.

route_initial_transition_support_compati.description: Apply the selected support mode when Character Select first enters support selection while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_confirmation_support_compa.description: Apply the selected support mode to the primary support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_refreshed_support_list_population.description: Refresh each player's support list through the selected mode's eligibility rules.

route_repeated_confirmation_support_comp.description: Apply the selected support mode to the repeated support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_fighter_confirmation.description: After fighter confirmation, restore the support last finalized for the same fighter; a new fighter starts on the native default in all mode and No Support otherwise, using the native carousel anchor in all mode and compact centering otherwise; finalize immediately when No Support is the only entry.

route_repeated_fighter_confirmation.description: Apply the same support restore and No-Support-only direct finalization to the repeated fighter-confirmation path.

route_support_confirmation_without_linke.description: Remember the selected support and finalize it in Auto linked mode without opening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_no_support_only_return_to_fighter_.description: Return a finalized No-Support-only fighter directly to fighter selection, or a larger roster directly to support selection in Auto linked mode, without reopening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_selected_support_display_id.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its name rectangle.

route_selected_support_name_draw.description: Render the table-defined name for an added support and retain the complete native selected-name path for ordinary supports.

route_selected_support_portrait_display_.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its large portrait resource.

route_support_cell_draw.description: Draw only the single non-wrapped occurrence of each entry in a compact support carousel; all mode keeps every native cell.

route_support_draw_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's draw eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_navigation_left_without_wr.description: Delegate native left navigation except at the first compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place; all mode keeps native wrapping.

route_support_navigation_right_without_w.description: Delegate native right navigation except at the last compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place; all mode keeps native wrapping.

route_support_navigation_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's navigation eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_list_available_display_id.description: Resolve an available scrollable-list entry through its table-defined display record.

route_support_list_primary_display_id.description: Resolve the primary scrollable-list entry path through its table-defined display record.

defaults.control_settings.description: Expose separate Guard, Substitution, Item Select L and R actions and an Unbound choice in ordered selectors without the native editor's eight-action permutation restriction.

skip_native_item_select_badge.description: Branch past the native item-select badge draw, which reads P1's binding for both panels and draws an empty frame for an unbound action.

command_list_pill_tokens.description: Draw Command List tokens 26 through 28, for Select, L3, and R3, through the shoulder glyph branch.

queue_control_settings_help_on_reset.description: Queue the Controls help instruction during the shared reset, before the first Controls draw.

select_held_guard_behavior.description: After timing admission, accept the added Substitution binding before the held-Guard limit: held with Substitution Input set to Hold, otherwise freshly pressed in the window; native Guard/Sub input keeps the vanilla limit.

select_substitution_history_action.description: Search both native Guard/Sub bindings and the added Substitution binding independently in buffered input.

select_logical_block_source.description: Keep native Guard/Sub 2 and the added Guard binding as logical Guard sources.

open_extended_bindings.description: Read the native bindings plus added Guard, Substitution, and Item Select L and R into the ten action rows, and write the L3 and R3 cells into the shoulder-button texture.

rebuild_command_list_bindings.description: After the battle Command List builds its rows, show each action's active button instead of the native binding.

command_list_shoulder_glyphs_high.description: Draw Command List shoulder tokens, including L3 and R3, from the added glyph table.

command_list_shoulder_glyphs_low.description: Complete the Command List shoulder glyph table address.

command_list_shoulder_widths_high.description: Advance past Command List shoulder tokens by the added glyph table's widths.

command_list_shoulder_widths_low.description: Complete the Command List shoulder width address.

command_list_pill_draw.description: Draw Command List shoulder, L3, R3, and Select tokens as Control Settings pills.

command_list_texts_high.description: Read Command List condition texts from the rebuilt text table.

command_list_texts_low.description: Complete the Command List text table address.

chart_button_tokens.description: Convert the move chart's first four bindings to tokens for every button.

chart_glyphs_high.description: Draw move-chart face and button tokens from the added glyph table.

chart_glyphs_low.description: Complete the move-chart glyph table address.

chart_pill_draw.description: Draw move-chart shoulder, L3, R3, and Select tokens as Control Settings pills.

skip_zero_binding_in_history_match.description: Keep an unbound native action from matching every history record in the binding match wrapper.

skip_zero_binding_in_history_count.description: Keep an unbound native action from counting every history record in the binding count wrapper.

skip_zero_native_binding.description: Keep an unbound native action from matching a buffered button press.

select_item_select_r.description: Deliver Item Select L and R presses through the native item-select and reverse item-select input bits.

draw_item_select_badges.description: Draw the bound Item Select L and R badges from the panel's own side before the item wheel.

reverse_item_select.description: Step the selected battle item backward when the reverse item-select input arrives.

load_default_bindings_for_profile_init_h.description: Read the generated default layout when initializing the controller banks.

load_default_bindings_for_profile_init_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_bank_reset_hig.description: Read the generated default layout when resetting every controller bank.

load_default_bindings_for_bank_reset_low.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_player_reset_h.description: Read the generated default layout when resetting one player's bindings.

load_default_bindings_for_player_reset_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_battle_input_h.description: Read the generated default layout when a battle input object has no profile.

load_default_bindings_for_battle_input_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_vibration_high.description: Read the generated vibration default when the controller settings start cold.

load_default_vibration_low.description: Complete the generated vibration default address.

replace_row_navigation.description: Navigate all eleven rows, enter editing, confirm, and restore the generated defaults.

replace_row_editing.description: Edit the selected row: step its action, toggle vibration, assign, or cancel.

replace_row_cells.description: Draw the eleven center cells, including L3 and R3 from the shoulder-button texture.

replace_row_labels.description: Draw the eleven rows of labels with the cursor and row frame.
